column3: It gets summarized five times before it reaches the CEO.
By then, the signal is gone.
Cortex captures the original observation, connects it to everything the company already knows, and shows what actually changed.
Sarah says one sentence after her call. Slack, support tickets, GitHub and email flow in the same way. Nobody writes a report.
River understands every signal. A QM agent grounds each one against the company's memory in GBrain, and routes it to whoever has to act.
Different people on different teams saw the same problem. Cortex connected them. Three hundred and forty thousand dollars now depends on SAML.
The CEO approves in one click. The decision is written to company memory, and an agent assigns the owner and drafts the plan.
Every claim has a source. Unsourced claims are rejected.
River, QM and GBrain. One loop, owned by the company.
AI tools made each person faster. Cortex makes the company itself faster.
